schema.text: Should a continuous cycle lane or path be added here?
schema.help: A continuous cycle lane or path runs along the whole stretch without gaps.

en.#Should a continuous cycle lane or path: Should a continuous cycle lane or path be added here?
en.#A continuous cycle lane or path runs al: A continuous cycle lane or path runs along the whole stretch without gaps.

it.#Should a continuous cycle lane or path: Servirebbe qui una corsia o pista ciclabile continua?
it.#A continuous cycle lane or path runs al: Una corsia o pista ciclabile continua percorre tutto il tratto senza interruzioni.

fr.#Should a continuous cycle lane or path: Faudrait-il ajouter ici une bande ou piste cyclable continue ?
fr.#A continuous cycle lane or path runs al: Une bande ou piste cyclable continue suit tout le tronçon sans interruption.

de.#Should a continuous cycle lane or path: Sollte hier ein durchgehender Radfahrstreifen oder Radweg angelegt werden?
de.#A continuous cycle lane or path runs al: Ein durchgehender Radstreifen oder Radweg verläuft ohne Lücken über den ganzen Abschnitt.

tr.#Should a continuous cycle lane or path: Buraya kesintisiz bir bisiklet şeridi veya yolu eklenmeli mi?
tr.#A continuous cycle lane or path runs al: Kesintisiz bisiklet şeridi veya yolu, bölüm boyunca hiç kesilmeden devam eder.

fa.#Should a continuous cycle lane or path: آیا باید اینجا یک خط یا مسیر دوچرخه پیوسته اضافه شود؟
fa.#A continuous cycle lane or path runs al: خط یا مسیر دوچرخهٔ پیوسته بدون قطعی در تمام این بخش امتداد دارد.

hu.#Should a continuous cycle lane or path: Kellene-e itt folyamatos kerékpársávot vagy -utat kialakítani?
hu.#A continuous cycle lane or path runs al: A folyamatos kerékpársáv vagy kerékpárút megszakítás nélkül fut végig a teljes szakaszon.

ar.#Should a continuous cycle lane or path: هل يجب إضافة مسار أو ممر متصل للدراجات هنا؟
ar.#A continuous cycle lane or path runs al: حارة أو مسار الدراجات المتصل يمتد على طول المقطع كله بلا انقطاع.
